reason: Our ERP already has a student app that pushes notices, so paying nine lakh a year for a second feed is hard to justify to the committee. I might let one batch try the free pilot, but nothing about this moves our NAAC or NIRF numbers as it is pitched.
objection: It duplicates what our ERP vendor already gives us, and a small Hyderabad startup getting into our Microsoft 365 and ERP data is a risk the committee and IT will question, DPDP agreement or not.
would_change_my_mind: A pilot report from a college like ours showing a clear drop in missed submissions, packaged as evidence we can cite under NAAC student support and progression criteria.
